purpose: The file set the provider-live-claude exercise actually compiles and runs, republished as it stands at this task's observation commit so a gate can recompute it and measure the intersection required by docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md section 4, G6b, instead of accepting an argument about which edits were harmless. This supersedes nothing: V2-075's artifact stays byte-unchanged and remains the correct set for judging V2-075's own record.

exercise.subtest_note: Listed in execution order. Each entry is an object rather than a bare string so that no high-entropy value ever sits directly after the one name containing a secret-scan trigger keyword; the repository's secret scan flags that adjacency. The count is nine and the exercise was not widened: V2-080's working-directory proof is carried as two NESTED phases under I2_wire_and_identity (f_declared_working_directory_reported_by_the_real_child_unconfined and g_declared_working_directory_reported_by_the_real_child_under_confinement) and as one additional assertion inside I5_I6_crash_resume, so no tenth top-level subtest exists and the published set is not enlarged by a new top-level phase.

compiled.how: Every package of the repository's own module reported by `go list -deps -test ./internal/runner`, contributing GoFiles, CgoFiles and EmbedFiles only, intersected with `git ls-files`. TestGoFiles and XTestGoFiles are deliberately NOT added per package: go list reports the test-augmented variant of internal/runner with its in-package test files already folded into that variant's GoFiles, so taking GoFiles alone yields exactly what the test binary compiles (measured at this observation commit: all 45 files of internal/runner, 20 non-test sources plus 25 test files, plus every dependency's non-test sources) and does not wrongly pull in dependency packages' own test files, which the binary never compiles. The one entry go list reports that is not a repository file, the generated _testmain.go under the go build cache, is dropped by intersecting with `git ls-files`; a git diff can only ever name tracked paths, so that intersection loses nothing. Measured 2026-08-26: 92 paths, up from V2-075's 67, with 25 paths added and none removed.

delta_against_v2_075.why: The exercise itself was not widened. The growth is entirely the runner package's and its dependencies' own growth since 2026-08-25: internal/runner gained the source-control and forge-publication families (git.go, sourcecontrol.go, publishsource.go, forgepublish.go and their tests, including two additional live-gated test files) and V2-077's working_directory_test.go; internal/application gained seven files including provider_registry.go and human_input.go; internal/provider gained breaker.go, compatibility.go, pool.go and usagewindow.go; and internal/scheduler entered the closure for the first time with decision.go, priority.go and scheduler.go. Every one of these is compiled into the same test binary, so every one of them is inside G6b's judged surface whether or not TestProviderLiveVerticalSlice reads it.

runtime_read.how: Repository files the exercise opens while running, not compiled into it. internal/runner.LoadPreflightRecord reads contracts/schemas/provider-preflight.json, reads the approved record itself, reads the file named by that record's approval.subject_path, and then calls internal/contracts.CheckProviderPreflightLedger, which reads and schema-validates EVERY record under .agents/v2/provider-preflight/ and re-checks each one's approval.subject_digest against the real bytes of its subject_path. Measured 2026-08-26 by reading that function: the directory walk is unconditional, so all five records now present are read on every load, which is two more than V2-075 published because only three records existed at d9f98ae573e617aafd82d87fa1c35f9bd6e26ffb. Measured, not assumed: grep of the compiled set finds no reference to scripts/, no //go:embed directive, and the only external programs the exercise starts are those listed under out_of_tree_executables.

toolchain_pins.how: Files that fix what the compiled set is compiled and run with: go.mod and go.sum fix the module graph and the Go language and toolchain version (go.mod is also stat-ed at run time by the suite's mustRepoRoot), devbox.json and devbox.lock fix the Go toolchain binary and the shell the exercise runs inside. The Makefile is not in the set because this exercise is invoked as `go test` directly and no make target takes part in it.

out_of_tree_executables.why_not_a_repository_path: The provider CLI lives outside the repository, so it can never appear in a git diff and cannot be covered by the intersection at all. Its identity is pinned instead by provider.executable_path and provider.version in the approved preflight record: internal/runner.CostLedger.Reserve refuses before spending anything unless the adapter's argv[0] resolves to exactly that absolute path, and the record's read-only verification entry re-checks the version with the record's own declared argv.

New at this observation relative to V2-075's set: I2's confined phase (V2-080 A8) sets ProcessSupervisor.Confine, so NamespaceConfinement.wrap starts the child through unshare and sh rather than directly. resolveTool prefers the caller's PATH and falls back to /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin and /sbin; measured under devbox run --pure, whose PATH contains no /usr/bin, the /usr/bin fallback is what resolves it. Neither binary is a repository path, so neither can appear in a git diff.

out_of_tree_executables.resolved_target: resolved from the devbox --pure PATH by internal/runner.resolveTool
out_of_tree_executables.version: bash 5.3p15 as provided by the devbox environment
out_of_tree_executables.why_not_a_repository_path: Used only as the interpreter of the mount-and-cd script NamespaceConfinement.wrap builds; it executes no repository file and is not a repository path.

excluded_with_reason.reason: internal/contracts.CheckProviderPreflightLedger, which LoadPreflightRecord calls on every load, reads .agents/v2/evidence/index.json and then every evidence file the index names for an entry whose component begins with "provider-live-". These are excluded from the judged set because they are the artifact the observation writes: this task's record and its index entry land after the observation, so including them would make the G6b claim unsatisfiable for any live record whatsoever, not just this one. Excluding them is not a gap in coverage. The evidence ledger's integrity is re-executed at the judging commit rather than argued about: `make check` runs `go test ./internal/contracts`, whose TestProviderPreflightLedgerPassesOnTheRealTree re-runs CheckProviderPreflightLedger over the real tree and whose TestActiveEvidenceIndex re-checks the index-to-file bijection and every evidence_hash. That is freshness by re-execution, which is G6a, and it is why these inputs do not need G6b's intersection. Measured 2026-08-26 and recorded as a finding rather than repaired: this task's own record carries component "runner" because acceptance item A17 requires exactly that, and "runner" does not begin with "provider-live-", so unlike V2-017's, V2-022's, V2-063's and V2-075's records this one is NOT selected by that filter and its artifact_refs-to-preflight-digest binding and its approved_at-before-observed_at ordering are therefore not enforced by CheckProviderPreflightLedger. The binding and the ordering are nevertheless both present and both correct in the record, so the gap is in the check's reach, not in the record.

argv: set -eu; OBS=563314b45138353baaffb4987424239fb9d61a38; JUDGE="$1"; python3 -c "import json;print(chr(10).join(json.load(open('.agents/v2/evidence/artifacts/V2-080-live-exercise-files.json'))['paths']))" | LC_ALL=C sort -u > /tmp/v2-080-set.txt; git diff --name-only "$OBS" "$JUDGE" | LC_ALL=C sort -u > /tmp/v2-080-diff.txt; comm -12 /tmp/v2-080-set.txt /tmp/v2-080-diff.txt; printf "intersection_lines=%s\n" "$(comm -12 /tmp/v2-080-set.txt /tmp/v2-080-diff.txt | wc -l)"
measure_the_intersection.expected: no path lines, then intersection_lines=0. Any path line at all means the diff since the observation touches a file the exercise compiles or runs, and G6b then requires re-observation regardless of what the change was.
measure_the_intersection.note: Pass the judging commit-ish as the single positional argument. The two revisions are passed to git diff as separate arguments rather than as a two-dot range on purpose, so no digest in this file is ever followed by more than one punctuation character. The observation commit is also reachable through the durable ref refs/live-observations/v2-080-provider-live-claude, which is pushed to origin, so this measurement stays possible on a fresh clone.
